title: Mexico’s Milk for Well-being Is Now 100% National Production
author: Alexia Villaseñor and Jared Laureles
content:
_This article by Alexia Villaseñor and Jared Laureles originally appeared in
the[September 14, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/09/14/economia/018n2eco), Mexico's
premier left-wing daily newspaper._

In two years, Milk for Well-being went from importing 40 percent of its inputs
to **supplying itself 100 percent with the production of Mexican cattle
ranchers** , highlighted Antonio Talamantes, director of the state-owned
company.

> "All the milk, both powdered and liquid, comes from our producers, something
> that gives us great pride. In addition, it is 99.1 milk and 0.9
> fortifications with vitamin A, B2, B12, C, vitamin C, zinc, folic acid,
> iron," the official elaborated in an interview with La Jornada.

Since 2024, **purchases from Mexican producers have doubled** , going from 340
million liters of dairy at the start of this six-year term to 760 million,
with the goal of reaching **1.3 billion liters by the end of the
administration** , Talamantes indicated.

He mentioned that the milk is purchased from companies in 14 states, and it is
expected to have a registry in 20 federal entities in the coming years.
Jalisco is the main producing state, where almost one million liters are
acquired daily, followed by Chihuahua and Veracruz.

To become a distributor, he explained, ranchers must register and meet a
series of requirements; among them, the sanitation parameters for the milk.
Once accredited, they are given a code so they can deliver the product to the
63 existing collection centers.

Milk for Well-being is distributed to **more than 7 million families and
expects to reach 10 million**.
